title: Confident, Calibrated, or Complicit: Probing the Trade-offs between Safety Alignment and Ideological Bias in Language Models in Detecting Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Inducing political personas (Progressive, Conservative, Libertarian, Centrist) via system prompts to measure changes in hate speech classification accuracy, false positive/negative rates, and evaluating model performance disparities when classifying hate speech aimed at specific political target groups (e.g., progressives, conservatives).

Disaggregating and comparing strict classification accuracy and refusal rates for hate speech directed at various racial and ethnic target groups (e.g., whites, black folks, people of color, non-whites) to identify unequal protection.
Disaggregating and comparing strict classification accuracy and refusal rates for hate speech directed at religious target groups (e.g., muslims, jews, jewish_people).
Disaggregating and comparing strict classification accuracy and refusal rates for hate speech directed at immigrant populations (e.g., immigrants, illegal immigrants).
